scope: Kubernetes v1.36.1 native ServiceAccounts, Pods, namespaced Roles and RoleBindings, and three case-owned ConfigMaps. Three ordinary synthetic Pods begin with a shared account and are recreated with distinct Training, Inference, and Pipeline accounts. The case reviews named ConfigMap GET authorization using ephemeral authorization.k8s.io/v1 SubjectAccessReviews and does not use workload credentials. External cloud IAM, federated identities, admission mapping enforcement, Kubeflow, KServe, training operators, production resources, and actual model environments are outside this case.

checks.claim: The ordinary synthetic workloads run under three distinct explicit Kubernetes ServiceAccounts
Each RoleBinding binds one workload ServiceAccount to a Role permitting only get on its exact harmless ConfigMap
API-server authorization preserves each workload's exact named read and withholds the other two named reads
